competency.outcome: Derive a formal or quantitative account of policy gradients using a sampled policy-gradient estimator. Have a separate evaluator hold unseen items and answer keys.

topic_kernel.measure: return and gradient variance across seeds

competency.practice_task: Produce a stepwise derivation with units or invariants grounded in a sampled policy-gradient estimator.
competency.setting_constraint: Have a separate evaluator hold unseen items and answer keys.
required_evidence: a stepwise derivation with units or invariants
Include item-set hash, evaluator identity and aggregate verdict only.
Report return and gradient variance across seeds with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of policy gradients.
Practice: the derivation reproduces a checked special case.
Measurement: report return and gradient variance across seeds against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for reporting a single lucky rollout; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
